# volcano_database_restore (Resource)

Triggers a one-shot restore of a database from a named backup or a point in time. This is a one-shot operation modeled as create+read only: removing it from configuration only drops it from state, it does not undo the restore (the API has no way to reverse one).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_database_restore" "rollback" {
  project_id    = volcano_project.example.id
  database_name = volcano_database.main.name
  backup_name   = volcano_database_backup.before_migration.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_name` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `backup_name` (String) Exactly one of backup_name or restore_to must be set. Forces replacement if changed.
- `restore_to` (String) RFC 3339 point in time within the backup retention window. Forces replacement if changed.

### Read-Only

- `completed_at` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `error` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `kind` (String)
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_database_restore.rollback <project-id>,<database-name>,<restore-id>
```
